item_fields.name: node_id

item_fields.name: prize

global_fields.name: max_length

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a location (a sampling site or the base camp); used to reference the site when building the circuit. Each non-depot site may be visited at most once.

item_fields.name: prize
